\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 165-168 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R173-first-pass-words-from-chapters-165-168}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tree trunk and mud.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a light bulb, a remote control, a laptop, a printer, a charger
  \item a sari, a belt, an earring, a necklace, a bangle
  \item a pistachio, a raisin, a fruit preserve, a cake, sweets
  \item a duck, an owl, a whale, cricket, football
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A light bulb? (\textbf{\ur{بلب}}, \emph{balb}.) A remote control? (\textbf{\ur{ریموٹ}}, \emph{rimoṭ}.) A laptop? (\textbf{\ur{لیپ} \ur{ٹاپ}}, \emph{laipṭāp}.) A printer? (\textbf{\ur{پرنٹر}}, \emph{printar}.) A charger? (\textbf{\ur{چارجر}}, \emph{chārjar}.) A sari? (\textbf{\ur{ساڑی}}, \emph{sāṛī}.) A belt? (\textbf{\ur{بیلٹ}}, \emph{belṭ}.) An earring? (\textbf{\ur{بالی}}, \emph{bālī}.) A necklace? (\textbf{\ur{ہار}}, \emph{hār}.) A bangle? (\textbf{\ur{چوڑی}}, \emph{chūṛī}.) A pistachio? (\textbf{\ur{پستہ}}, \emph{pistā}.) A raisin? (\textbf{\ur{کشمش}}, \emph{kishmish}.) A fruit preserve? (\textbf{\ur{مربہ}}, \emph{murabbā}.) A cake? (\textbf{\ur{کیک}}, \emph{keik}.) Sweets? (\textbf{\ur{مٹھائی}}, \emph{miṭhāī}.) A duck? (\textbf{\ur{بطخ}}, \emph{batakh}.) An owl? (\textbf{\ur{الو}}, \emph{ullū}.) A whale? (\textbf{\ur{وہیل}}, \emph{vhel}.) Cricket? (\textbf{\ur{کرکٹ}}, \emph{krikeṭ}.) Football? (\textbf{\ur{فٹ} \ur{بال}}, \emph{fuṭbāl}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 169-173 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R173-second-pass-words-from-chapters-169-173}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a flute, a dance, an exhibition, a fair, a celebration
  \item a human being, an elder, parents, an uncle, an aunt
  \item a citizen, a tourist, a sentence, a character, a meaning
  \item surprise, calm, peace, a war, freedom
  \item a wall clock, a flowerpot, a plant, a tree trunk, mud
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A flute? (\textbf{\ur{بانسری}}, \emph{bāṅsurī}.) A dance? (\textbf{\ur{ناچ}}, \emph{nāch}.) An exhibition? (\textbf{\ur{نمائش}}, \emph{numāish}.) A fair? (\textbf{\ur{میلہ}}, \emph{melā}.) A celebration? (\textbf{\ur{جشن}}, \emph{jashn}.) A human being? (\textbf{\ur{انسان}}, \emph{insān}.) An elder? (\textbf{\ur{بزرگ}}, \emph{buzurg}.) Parents? (\textbf{\ur{والدین}}, \emph{vālidain}.) An uncle? (\textbf{\ur{چچا}}, \emph{chachā}.) An aunt? (\textbf{\ur{چچی}}, \emph{chachī}.) A citizen? (\textbf{\ur{شہری}}, \emph{shahrī}.) A tourist? (\textbf{\ur{سیاح}}, \emph{sayyāh}.) A sentence? (\textbf{\ur{جملہ}}, \emph{jumlā}.) A character? (\textbf{\ur{حرف}}, \emph{harf}.) A meaning? (\textbf{\ur{مطلب}}, \emph{matlab}.) Surprise? (\textbf{\ur{حیرت}}, \emph{hairat}.) Calm? (\textbf{\ur{سکون}}, \emph{sukūn}.) Peace? (\textbf{\ur{امن}}, \emph{aman}.) A war? (\textbf{\ur{جنگ}}, \emph{jang}.) Freedom? (\textbf{\ur{آزادی}}, \emph{āzādī}.) A wall clock? (\textbf{\ur{دیوار} \ur{گھڑی}}, \emph{dīvār ghaṛī}.) A flowerpot? (\textbf{\ur{گملا}}, \emph{gamlā}.) A plant? (\textbf{\ur{پودا}}, \emph{paudā}.) A tree trunk? (\textbf{\ur{تنا}}, \emph{tanā}.) Mud? (\textbf{\ur{کیچڑ}}, \emph{kīchaṛ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
